positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on the Data Center Resource Management team, which manages the single authoritative source of capacity for datacenter space, power, cooling, and networking. Using C#, ASP.NET, Service Fabric, Cosmos DB, React, and TypeScript.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Worked on the ground software team to write software to control satellites using C#, ASP.NET, TypeScript, React and MSSQL.

Doing frontend and backend feature development, bug fixes, performance investigations / improvements and resolving multithreading issues as they arise.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on the Minecraft Creator Team where we explored building a Unreal / Unity type editor for the Minecraft creator community. Focus was on using web technologies like JavaScript / HTML inside / alongside of a C++ game engine to appeal to a larger audience.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Microsoft Azure PlayFab as an engineer on the Game Manager web portal and billing teams.

Full stack development using C#, ASP.NET, TypeScript, React, AWS and Azure.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on a in-house real time 3D game editor similar to Unreal Editor and Unity in C#, WPF and C++.

User facing work to help debug issues, optimize workflow and understand needs, performance analysis work to find and fix performance issues (memory, CPU and threading), research and prototype work for future systems and foundational editor system and architecture work.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on the developer platform team for Microsoft HoloLens.

Maintenance, debugging and support work for real time compositing software used to composite holograms onto a live video feed. Used for stage demos, commercials and promotional videos.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Lead (Tools)
positions.description:
Worked on a real time 3D game editor similar to Unreal Editor and Unity.

Collaborated with disciplines across the studio (creative and engineering) to implement editor features and resolve pain points. Responsible for core editor functionality and editor’s interaction with native game systems. Profiling work to identify and resolve performance issues including reducing strain on CLR garbage collector, minimizing managed to native transitions and reducing WPF overhead. Educated team about performance best practices and how to profile the editor to find hot spots. Led initiative to replace out of process telnet based test automation with in process C# automated tests. Change made test creation and debugging significantly easier. Planning, scheduling, guidance and performance management for direct reports.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of the GameCircle team working on Android SDK for the service. Worked on offline event handling, SDK prep for new hardware, collaboration with service engineers to develop new SDK features and bug fixing.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Worked as a senior software engineer on the tools team for an unannounced MMO.

Responsible for design and implementation of in house UI system similar to Qt and wxWidgets and the project's level editor. Worked closely with designers, artists and engineers to gather requirements for editor. Core of editor functionality was broken into libraries so that it could be shared by other tools.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked as a software engineer on an application to visualize data collected from race cars in 3D.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Game programmer on World of Warcraft.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a programmer on the Starcraft: Ghost project at Blizzard Console.  In August of 2006 was redeployed to a new position on the World of Warcraft team.

Responsible for design and architecture of game systems, general game programming tasks, character programming and guidance of other programmers and designers.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Worked as a gameplay programmer on the game Metal Arms - Glitch In The System.  Swingin' Ape Studios was acquired by Blizzard Entertainment in May of 2005.
